name: Jellywave
description: Adds a SUB/WAVE radio station tile to My Media on every Jellyfin client. Click the tile, press play, hear the station.
overview: SUB/WAVE internet radio as a My Media entry.

versions.changelog: Requires Jellyfin 12.3. Station page routes now answer only users who can see the channel and refuse API keys; a request's status is visible only to the user who sent it; station redirects are refused; station URLs with credentials, a query or a fragment are refused and the config page says why; covers are checked by content; a channel name clash with another plugin stops Jellywave instead of touching the other channel; access grants run one at a time; the 'visible to every user' setting is now a one-shot button and no longer re-adds the station after an admin removes it.
Takeovers detected by show id; poller status reads as one snapshot and says when it is waiting for the first poll.
Poller status on the plugin page; schedule honours the station's takeovers; small page tidy-ups.
Station page layout: cover, now playing and the request box side by side, panels in a row; a refused like keeps the heart; schedule keeps its clock.
Station page extras: DJ portrait, up next, recently played, like button, today's programme, lyrics panel when the station enables them.
Cover art and what is up next on the live item; optional station page (needs the File Transformation plugin) with live track, DJ, show, requests, and a playing bar that follows the track.
Make the station visible to every user from the plugin page (off by default); new users and policy saves are covered.
